title: Allen Developing Mouse Brain Reference Atlas, P4: 3D annotation volume and structure ontology
license: Allen Institute Terms of Use (https://alleninstitute.org/terms-of-use/): research or other noncommercial use, citation required
citation: Allen Developing Mouse Brain Atlas, developingmouse.brain-map.org (Allen Institute for Brain Science, 2008); Thompson CL et al. (2014) A high-resolution spatiotemporal atlas of gene expression of the developing mouse brain. Neuron 83:309-323.
notes: The zip holds annotation.mhd + annotation.raw (uint32 labels, 724 x 403 x 398 voxels of 16.752 x 16.752 x 20 um, RAI); unpack it with examples/allen_unpack_annotation.py. structure_graph_17.json is the API's 'Developing Mouse 3' structure graph (ontology 12). At P4 the volume labels prosomeric plates only (77 labels, e.g. p2A, alar thalamus), not thalamic nuclei.
